title: Fill Salon Gaps from Your Waitlist
summary: Keep a salon suite or solo stylist front desk answering while you work, then pull the next waitlist client into open chairs without losing the thread.

money_potential.label: Medium
money_potential.basis: Assumes you already have a waitlist or missed booking messages; the value is filling open chairs you already could sell.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: Open slots filled from people already waiting.
Fewer missed booking messages while you are with a client.
who_its_for: Salon suite renters and solo stylists.
Small medspa operators without a full desk team.
